# Comparison task cp82-title

The authority of checkpoint CP82, a T3.6 L4 comparison task. It is not
a Pactwright specification.

## 1. Behaviour

The title case of a text upper-cases the first character of each word and
lower-cases its other characters, as JavaScript's toUpperCase and toLowerCase
do. Words are separated by single spaces, which are kept. The empty text has
the empty title case.
